'''Niroida''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. She was the [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] of the [[Vriisan irstat]] a Tarasin tribe, until about 30 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when she was succeeded by [[Kasslan]].
